nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: 08:20 Europe/Kyiv daily. The 12-month window ends yesterday (complete days only).

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: outputSheetId/outputSheetTab: where the export is written (tab "LACASINO" must exist; it is cleared and rewritten on every run). Athena settings as in the other exports.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "QueryString": "with params as (
    select date '2026-01-01'                         as lifetime_from, -- «всё время»
           current_date - interval '12' month        as date_from,     -- окно 12M
           current_date                              as date_to_excl   -- по вчера включительно
),

payments as (
    -- успешные депозиты и выводы: 12M и последний депозит за всё время
    select b.player_hk,
           sum(case when b.transaction_type = 'deposit'
                     and b.as_of_date >= p.date_from
                    then b.transaction_count else 0 end)        as deposit_count_12m,
           sum(case when b.transaction_type = 'deposit'
                     and b.as_of_date >= p.date_from
                    then b.amount_eur else 0 end)               as deposit_amount_12m,
           sum(case when b.transaction_type = 'withdrawal'
                     and b.as_of_date >= p.date_from
                    then b.transaction_count else 0 end)        as withdrawal_count_12m,
           sum(case when b.transaction_type = 'withdrawal'
                     and b.as_of_date >= p.date_from
                    then abs(b.amount_eur) else 0 end)          as withdrawal_amount_12m,
           max(case when b.transaction_type = 'deposit'
                     and b.transaction_count > 0
                    then b.as_of_date end)                      as last_deposit_date
    from operator_ro_normcasino.agg_billing_daily b
    cross join params p
    where b.as_of_date >= least(p.lifetime_from, cast(p.date_from as date))
      and b.as_of_date <  p.date_to_excl
      and b.transaction_type   in ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
      and b.transaction_status = 'Success'
      and b.is_test = false
      and b.brand = 'LACASINO'
    group by 1
),

casino as (
    -- казино за 12M, EUR, канон GR8
    select d.player_hk,
           sum(d.casino_turnover_eur)                                 as turnover_casino_12m,
           sum(d.casino_ggr_eur)                                      as ggr_casino_12m,
           sum(d.casino_bets_count)                                   as bets_casino_12m,
           sum(coalesce(d.casino_bonus_eur, 0)
               + coalesce(d.casino_crm_bonuses_clear_amount_eur, 0))  as clear_bonus_casino_12m
    from operator_ro_normcasino.agg_product_dashboard_daily d
    cross join params p
    where d.as_of_date >= p.date_from
      and d.as_of_date <  p.date_to_excl
      and d.is_test = false
      and d.brand = 'LACASINO'
    group by 1
),

mail as (
    -- письма за 12M: отправки, доставки, открытия, последнее открытие
    select c.player_hk,
           sum(c.sent_cnt)                                     as sent_12m,
           sum(c.delivered_cnt)                                as delivered_12m,
           sum(c.opened_cnt)                                   as opened_12m,
           max(case when c.opened_cnt > 0 then c.action_date end) as last_open_date
    from operator_ro_normcasino.agg_communications_daily c
    cross join params p
    where c.action_date >= p.date_from
      and c.action_date <  p.date_to_excl
      and c.channel = 'mail'
      and c.brand = 'LACASINO'
    group by 1
),

rates as (
    -- курс валюта → EUR на дату; max() страхует от дублей в справочнике
    select r.from_currency,
           r.exchange_date,
           max(r.inverted_rate) as inverted_rate
    from operator_ro_normcasino.d_fx_rate r
    where r.to_currency = 'EUR'
    group by 1, 2
)

select ps.brand                                                         as "Brand",
       ps.player_id                                                     as "Account",
       ps.risk_business_segment                                         as "Risk business segment",
       ps.risk_casino_segment                                           as "Risk casino segment",
       dp.phone                                                         as "Phone",
       dp.email                                                         as "Email",
       ps.is_email_verified                                             as "Email verified",
       ps.aff_id                                                        as "Aff id",
       pay.last_deposit_date                                            as "Last Deposit date",
       coalesce(pay.deposit_count_12m, 0)                               as "Deposit count 12M",
       round(coalesce(pay.deposit_amount_12m, 0), 2)                    as "Deposit amount 12M",
       round(coalesce(pay.withdrawal_amount_12m, 0), 2)                 as "Withdrawal amount 12M",
       round(cast(cas.turnover_casino_12m as double)
             / nullif(cas.bets_casino_12m, 0), 2)                       as "Average bet Casino 12M",
       round(cast(pay.deposit_amount_12m as double)
             / nullif(pay.deposit_count_12m, 0), 2)                     as "Average deposit 12M",
       round(cas.ggr_casino_12m, 2)                                     as "GGR Casino 12M",
       round(case when ps.last_withdrawal_currency = 'EUR'
                  then abs(ps.last_withdrawal_amount)
                  else abs(ps.last_withdrawal_amount)
                       / nullif(r_lw.inverted_rate, 0)
             end, 2)                                                    as "Last withdrawal amount",
       round(cast(cas.ggr_casino_12m as double) * 100
             / nullif(cast(cas.turnover_casino_12m as double), 0), 2)   as "Margin Casino 12M, %",
       round(cas.ggr_casino_12m - cas.clear_bonus_casino_12m, 2)        as "NGR Casino 12M",
       round(cas.clear_bonus_casino_12m, 2)                             as "Total Casino Clear bonus amount 12M",
       coalesce(pay.withdrawal_count_12m, 0)                            as "Withdrawal count 12M",
       cast(ps.registration_date as timestamp(3))                       as "Registration date",
       cast(ps.first_deposit as timestamp(3))                           as "First Deposit date",
       cast(ps.first_bet_casino as timestamp(3))                        as "First Bet Casino date",
       cast(ps.last_bet_casino as timestamp(3))                         as "Last Bet Casino date",
       round(cast(cas.clear_bonus_casino_12m as double) * 100
             / nullif(cast(cas.ggr_casino_12m as double), 0), 2)        as "Bonus rate Casino 12M, %",
       cast(ps.last_withdrawal as timestamp(3))                         as "Last Withdrawal date",
       date_diff('day', pay.last_deposit_date, current_date)            as "LDD",
       round(cast(pay.deposit_amount_12m - pay.withdrawal_amount_12m as double) * 100
             / nullif(cast(pay.deposit_amount_12m as double), 0), 2)    as "Hold %",
       coalesce(m.sent_12m, 0)                                          as "Emails sent 12M",
       coalesce(m.opened_12m, 0)                                        as "Emails opened 12M",
       round(cast(m.opened_12m as double) * 100
             / nullif(m.delivered_12m, 0), 2)                           as "Email open rate 12M, %",
       m.last_open_date                                                 as "Last email open date"
from operator_ro_normcasino.agg_player_summary ps
join operator_ro_normcasino.d_player dp
  on dp.player_hk = ps.player_hk
left join payments pay
  on pay.player_hk = ps.player_hk
left join casino cas
  on cas.player_hk = ps.player_hk
left join mail m
  on m.player_hk = ps.player_hk
left join rates r_lw
  on r_lw.from_currency = ps.last_withdrawal_currency
 and r_lw.exchange_date = cast(ps.last_withdrawal as date)
where ps.is_test = false
  and coalesce(dp.is_test, false) = false
  -- только депозиторы: успешный депозит в billing за всё время
  and pay.last_deposit_date is not null
  and ps.brand = 'LACASINO'
  -- без стримеров
  and not exists (
        select 1
        from operator_ro_normcasino.d_risk_tags_summary st
        where st.player_hk = ps.player_hk
          and st.tag_id = 39
  )
order by "Brand", "GGR Casino 12M" desc nulls last, "Account"",
  "QueryExecutionContext": { "Database": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaDatabase }}", "Catalog": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaCatalog || 'AwsDataCatalog' }}" },
  "WorkGroup": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaWorkgroup || 'primary' }}",
  "ClientRequestToken": "n8n-players-12m-export-la-execution-{{ $execution.id }}"
  {{ $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation ? ', "ResultConfiguration": { "OutputLocation": "' + $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation + '" }' : '' }}
}

nodes.name: Execute Athena Query
nodes.notes: ClientRequestToken is derived from the execution id, so a retry of this node rejoins the same Athena query instead of starting a second one.

nodes.name: Poll Attempts Remaining?
nodes.notes: true -> wait and poll again; false -> give up after 120 polls (~30 min)

parameters.errorMessage: =Athena query {{ $json.QueryExecution.QueryExecutionId }} ended in state {{ $json.QueryExecution.Status.State }}. Reason: {{ $json.QueryExecution.Status.StateChangeReason || 'no StateChangeReason returned by Athena' }}. The sheet was not touched.

=Athena query {{ $('Execute Athena Query').first().json.QueryExecutionId }} did not finish within the polling budget of 120 polls x 15 s (~30 minutes). Last observed state: {{ $json.QueryExecution.Status.State }}. The sheet was not touched.

nodes.name: Clear Sheet
nodes.notes: Clears columns A:AZ of the tab, wider than the data, so leftovers from a longer run or an older column layout do not linger. Runs only once Athena reports SUCCEEDED, so a failed query leaves yesterday's data in place.

nodes.name: Get Athena Results Page
nodes.notes: Called once per page. Run 0 comes from Clear Sheet and has no NextToken; run N comes back from More Pages? and sends the NextToken that Parse Athena Page run N-1 received.

nodes.name: Append Page to Sheet
nodes.notes: One values:append call per Athena page (up to 1000 rows). Append writes below the last filled row and grows the grid as needed, so the tab never has to be pre-sized. Retries absorb Sheets rate limits (429).

nodes.name: More Pages?
nodes.notes: true -> fetch the next page with the NextToken of the page just written; false -> every page is in the sheet.
